questions.question: At which ground did Verunissa Reddy record their career-best innings (66, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Badgers on 2024/12/01.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 30, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/03/13.

questions.question: Nonkululeko Mlaba is the only South African woman to ever take a 10-wicket match haul in Test cricket. What were her match figures, against England in December 2024?
questions.explanation: Mlaba took 4 for 90 and 6 for 67 (10 for 157 in the match) against England at Bloemfontein in December 2024, the best match figures by a South African woman in Test history.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nthabiseng Nini holds it with 15, a joint record shared with Lizri de Villiers.
